exact_differences.original: Generates regional distribution maps, which are usually used to show the administrative divisions and coverage of a dataset. It is not suitable for showing the distribution of specific locations, such as urban administrative divisions, GDP distribution maps of provinces and cities across the country, etc. This tool is limited to generating data maps within China.
exact_differences.target: Generates regional distribution maps, which are usually used to show the administrative divisions and coverage of a dataset. It is not suitable for showing the distribution of specific locations, such as urban administrative divisions, GDP distribution maps of provinces and cities across the country, etc. This tool is limited to generating data maps within China.
exact_differences.updated: Generate regional distribution maps, usually used to show the administrative divisions and coverage of a dataset. Not suitable for showing the distribution of specific locations, such as urban administrative divisions, GDP distribution maps of provinces and cities across the country, etc. This tool is limited to generating data maps within China. Required: title (string) — the map title should not exceed 16 characters, and its content should be consistent with the information the map wants to convey and should be accurate, rich, creative, and attractive; data (object) with required name (string) — keywords for the Chinese name of an administrative region (must be within China) and must be one of China, province, city, district, or county; the name should be more specific and add attributive descriptions, e.g. '西安市' is better than '西安', '杭州西湖区' is better than '西湖区'; it cannot be a specific place name or a vague name such as '其它'. Optional within data: style (object) with fillColor (string, rgb or rgba format); colors (array of strings, default ['#1783FF', '#00C9C9', '#F0884D', '#D580FF', '#7863FF', '#60C42D', '#BD8F24', '#FF80CA', '#2491B3', '#17C76F'], rgb or rgba format); dataType (enum 'number' | 'enum') — the type of the data value, numeric or enumeration; dataLabel (string, e.g. 'GDP'); dataValue (string, numeric string or enumeration string); dataValueUnit (string, e.g. '万亿'); showAllSubdistricts (boolean, default false); subdistricts (array of objects with required name (same administrative-region keyword rules as above) and optional dataValue (string) and style (object with fillColor (string, rgb or rgba format))) — sub-administrative regions used to display the regional composition or regional distribution of related data. There are usually two scenarios: one is to simply display the regional composition, where only `fillColor` needs to be configured and all administrative divisions are consistent, representing that all blocks are connected as one; the other is the regional data distribution scenario, where you first determine the `dataType`, `dataValueUnit` and `dataLabel` configurations, `dataValue` should be a meaningful value consistent with the meaning of dataType, and then determine the style configuration. The `fillColor` configuration represents the default fill color for areas without data; lower-level administrative divisions do not need `fillColor` configuration, and their fill colors are determined by the `colors` configuration (if `dataType` is 'number', only one base color (warm color) is needed in the list to calculate the continuous data mapping color band; if `dataType` is 'enum', the number of color values in the list is equal to the number of enumeration values (contrast colors)). If `subdistricts` has a value, `showAllSubdistricts` must be set to true. Example: {"title": "陕西省地级市分布图", "data": {"name": "陕西省", "showAllSubdistricts": true, "dataLabel": "城市", "dataType": "enum", "colors": ["#4ECDC4", "#A5D8FF"], "subdistricts": [{"name": "西安市", "dataValue": "省会"}, {"name": "宝鸡市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "咸阳市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "铜川市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "渭南市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "延安市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "榆林市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "汉中市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "安康市", "dataValue": "地级市"}, {"name": "商洛市", "dataValue": "地级市"}]}, "width": 1000, "height": 1000}. Optional: width (number, default 1600); height (number, default 1000).

exact_differences.updated: Generate a point map to display the location and distribution of point data on the map, such as the location distribution of attractions, hospitals, supermarkets, etc. Required: title (string) — the map title should not exceed 16 characters, and its content should be consistent with the information the map wants to convey and should be accurate, rich, creative, and attractive; data, a non-empty array (minimum 1 item) of strings — a list of keywords for the names of points of interest (POIs) in Chinese. These POIs usually contain a group of places with similar locations, so the names should be more descriptive, adding attributives to indicate that they are different places in the same area, e.g. '北京市' is better than '北京', '杭州西湖' is better than '西湖'; in addition, if you can determine that a location may appear in multiple areas, you can be more specific, e.g. '杭州西湖的苏堤春晓' is better than '苏堤春晓'. The tool will use these keywords to search for specific POIs and query their detailed data, such as latitude and longitude, location photos, etc. For example, ['西安钟楼', '西安大唐不夜城', '西安大雁塔']. Optional: markerPopup (object) — marker type: one is simple mode, which is just an icon and does not require `markerPopup` configuration; the other is image mode, which displays location photos and requires `markerPopup` configuration. Contains type (string, default 'image'; must be 'image'), width (number, default 40 — width of the photo), height (number, default 40 — height of the photo) and borderRadius (number, default 8 — border radius of the photo); `width`/`height`/`borderRadius` can be combined to realize rectangular photos and square photos, and when `borderRadius` is half of the width and height, it can also be a circular photo. Optional: width (number, default 1600); height (number, default 1000).

exact_differences.original: Generate a radar chart to display multidimensional data (four dimensions or more), such as, evaluate Huawei and Apple phones in terms of five dimensions: ease of use, functionality, camera, benchmark scores, and battery life.
exact_differences.target: Generate a radar chart to display multidimensional data (four dimensions or more), such as, evaluate Huawei and Apple phones in terms of five dimensions: ease of use, functionality, camera, benchmark scores, and battery life.
exact_differences.updated: Generate a radar chart to display multidimensional data (four dimensions or more), such as evaluating Huawei and Apple phones in terms of five dimensions: ease of use, functionality, camera, benchmark scores, and battery life. Required: data, a non-empty array (minimum 1 item) of objects each with required `name` (string) and `value` (number) and optional `group` (string), e.g. [{ name: 'Design', value: 70 }]. Optional: style (object) with backgroundColor (string, e.g. '#fff'), palette (array of color strings), texture (enum 'default' | 'rough', default 'default'; 'rough' is hand-drawn style) and lineWidth (number, e.g. 4); theme (enum 'default' | 'academy' | 'dark', default 'default'); width (number, default 600); height (number, default 400); title (string, default '').

exact_differences.original: Generate a sankey chart to visualize the flow of data between different stages or categories, such as, the user journey from landing on a page to completing a purchase.
exact_differences.target: Generate a sankey chart to visualize the flow of data between different stages or categories, such as, the user journey from landing on a page to completing a purchase.
exact_differences.updated: Generate a sankey chart to visualize the flow of data between different stages or categories, such as the user journey from landing on a page to completing a purchase. Required: data, a non-empty array (minimum 1 item) of objects each with required source (string), target (string) and value (number), e.g. [{ source: 'Landing Page', target: 'Product Page', value: 50000 }, { source: 'Product Page', target: 'Add to Cart', value: 35000 }, { source: 'Add to Cart', target: 'Checkout', value: 25000 }, { source: 'Checkout', target: 'Payment', value: 15000 }, { source: 'Payment', target: 'Purchase Completed', value: 8000 }]. Optional: nodeAlign (enum 'left' | 'right' | 'justify' | 'center', default 'center') — alignment of nodes in the sankey chart; style (object) with backgroundColor (string, e.g. '#fff'), palette (array of color strings) and texture (enum 'default' | 'rough', default 'default'; 'rough' is hand-drawn style); theme (enum 'default' | 'academy' | 'dark', default 'default'); width (number, default 600); height (number, default 400); title (string, default '').

Required: data, a non-empty array (minimum 1 item) of objects each with required name (string) and value (number) and optional children (array of objects with required name and value and optional children, up to a maximum depth of 3), e.g. [{ name: 'Design', value: 70, children: [{ name: 'Tech', value: 20 }] }]. exact_differences.updated: Generate a Venn diagram to visualize the relationships between different sets, showing how they intersect and overlap, such as the commonalities and differences between various groups. Required: data, a non-empty array (minimum 1 item) of objects each with required value (number — value for the venn chart segment, e.g. 10, 20, or 30) and sets (array of strings — set names that this segment belongs to, e.g. ['A', 'B'] for an intersection between sets A and B) and optional label (string — label for the venn chart segment, e.g. 'A', 'B', or 'C'), e.g. [{ label: 'A', value: 10, sets: ['A'] }, { label: 'B', value: 20, sets: ['B'] }, { label: 'C', value: 30, sets: ['C'] }, { label: 'AB', value: 5, sets: ['A', 'B'] }]. Optional: style (object) with backgroundColor (string, e.g. '#fff'), palette (array of color strings) and texture (enum 'default' | 'rough', default 'default'; 'rough' is hand-drawn style); theme (enum 'default' | 'academy' | 'dark', default 'default'); width (number, default 600); height (number, default 400); title (string, default '').
